To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the f-modes of rotating magnetized stars are shifted by the magnetic field, and that the r-mode of slowly rotating stars is stabilized by a magnetic field.

the oscillation spectra of rotating stars endowed with purely poloidal and purely toroidal magnetic field components are very different, and that the f-mode is shifted in frequency by magnetic fields.

(i) the r-mode instability can be suppressed by toroidal magnetic fields; (ii) the a-mode frequency can increase by a factor of up to 2 in the presence of a strong magnetic field; (iii) the magnetic frequency shift of the f-mode is typically small (less than 0.5% for realistic neutron star magnetic fields).
In summary, our research is concerned with
the oscillations of rotating magnetised neutron stars with purely poloidal and purely toroidal magnetic field configurations.
the oscillations and instabilities of magnetized neutron stars.
the investigation of oscillations of rotating magnetised neutron stars endowed with a purely toroidal magnetic field.
